image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate covered in pink coralline algae and dark encrusting organisms. The chiton displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates with distinct ridges and mottled orange-brown coloration, surrounded by a leathery girdle with orange spots.
